method.title: Method
method.intro: Every engagement follows one process: humans set the direction, AI does the work, and acceptance is the final word. Six checkpoints keep scope, knowledge, and risk under control.

steps.label: Scope freeze
steps.description: Fix the goal and boundary on paper before any build.

steps.label: Knowledge freeze
steps.description: Lock the knowledge base so outputs stay reproducible.

steps.label: Guardrails
steps.description: Traceable citations plus a fallback: when the system does not know, it says so.

steps.label: Pilot log
steps.description: Log every pilot run so decisions can be reviewed later.

steps.label: Signed metrics
steps.description: Agree on the numbers before measuring, then sign the results.

steps.label: Signed acceptance
steps.description: Ship only when the buyer signs off.

solutions.title: AI Solutions
solutions.intro: Three entry points for trade & manufacturing. Every solution states the pain point, the approach, what is delivered, and how it is accepted.

items.name: Foreign Trade AI Assistant
items.pain: Quoting and customer follow-up are slow, inconsistent, and hard to trace across a busy trade team.
items.solution: An AI assistant that drafts and checks quotes and replies from your own price rules and product data, with citations back to the source.
items.deliverable: A working assistant configured to your workflow, plus usage documentation.
items.acceptance: It matches your quoting rules on a test set, every answer cites its source, and your team signs off on the pilot log.

items.name: Enterprise Knowledge Base RAG
items.pain: Company knowledge sits in scattered files; staff cannot find answers quickly, and new hires take long to ramp up.
items.solution: An on-premise RAG system that retrieves from your documents and answers with traceable citations and an "I don't know" fallback.
items.deliverable: On-prem deployment, a knowledge ingestion pipeline, and a signed acceptance checklist.
items.acceptance: Answers cite their sources; unsupported questions trigger the fallback; retrieval quality is measured and signed.

items.name: AI Business Automation
items.pain: Repetitive, multi-step business processes eat staff time and are error-prone.
items.solution: AI agents that automate one defined workflow with guardrails, logging, and human approval points.
items.deliverable: Automation for one defined workflow, plus a pilot log and a rollback plan.
items.acceptance: The workflow runs end-to-end in a pilot, every step is logged, and the owner signs the measured result.
